title: get_variables response
description:
JSON payload of the `get_variables` service response, found in `response.data.json_string.data` of the `urinterfaces/srv/VariablesViewer` service. The request is empty.

The response contains all shared variables, or an error object if the variables could not be read, for example because a second request was made within 500 ms.

Error.description: Returned instead of a variable update when the request failed.
